actions.name: get_os_build
actions.description: Get an Apple operating system build record by its AppleDB operating system name and build key.

os.description: Case-sensitive AppleDB operating system name (osStr), such as iOS, iPadOS, macOS, or Mac OS X.

build.description: AppleDB build key: usually the Apple build identifier, such as 22A3354, but simulator, RC, and SDK variants carry suffixes such as 22A3351-sim or 22H355-RC, and accessory firmware uses its version. Pass the build returned by search_os_builds verbatim; use search_os_builds when a plain build identifier is not found.

include_sources.description: Include firmware and software download sources; false keeps the result compact.

osStr.description: Marketing name of the operating system.

actions.name: search_os_builds
actions.description: Search an AppleDB firmware calendar by version, build, device identifier, or release text; results are newest first.

os_type.description: Case-sensitive AppleDB OS type that names the calendar, such as iOS, macOS, watchOS, tvOS, visionOS, bridgeOS, or HomePod Software. iPadOS builds live in the iOS calendar and audioOS builds in the HomePod Software calendar; each result carries its own os for get_os_build.

query.description: Search text, such as 18.0, 22A3354, or iPhone17,1.

limit.description: Maximum number of matches to return.

inputSchema.description: AppleDB operating system build search input.

os.description: AppleDB operating system name (osStr) for get_os_build; the iOS calendar also reports iPadOS, iPhone OS, and iPhone Software builds.

version.description: Version text from the calendar summary, such as 18.0, 18.1 beta 2, or 15.0 RC.

build.description: AppleDB build key for get_os_build; may carry a variant suffix such as -sim, -RC, or -SDK.

items.description: A compact AppleDB operating system build search result.

total_matches.description: Number of matches before applying the result limit.

truncated.description: Whether additional matches were omitted by the result limit.
